notes.title: The Arcane Tower area, the Knight unit, and the Protection spell!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Fight Lanceblade, the Knight boss of the Arcane Tower area! After defeating the boss, you'll get a new unit, the Knight, and a new spell, Protection![/b][/h3]

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New area with five new levels to play!
[*] New spell: Protection - Protects all friendly units within range. The protection shield dome lasts five turns. Enemy hits can weaken it.
[*] New unit: Knight - a strong melee unit that, when attacking, pushes the enemy back one square. 
[*] New Square: Spikes - Deadly Square. If a unit falls into this square, it dies!
[*] New tutorials showing the new elements: Protection spell / Knight unit / Spikes square.
[*] Added three levels of Arcane Tower to play in local/online matches.
[*] Rule fix: Teleport spell: Now can teleport to any square except adjacent to a boss/wizard (minimum distance from boss reduced to 2).
[*] Rule fix: Summon units: Now a unit can be summoned to any square except adjacent to a boss/wizard (minimum distance from boss reduced to 2).
[*] Bugfix: All bosses now have 15 HP and 4 damage.
[*] Bugfix: Dispel spell now removes all negative effects from the friendly units and all positive effects from the enemies within range.
[*] Minor visual fixes and text corrections.
[*] Memory usage optimization.
[*] Added some sounds fx.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Get involved in the development process![/h3]
We invite you to become an integral part of Slidemagi's development by joining our Discord community or leaving your comments in the discussions area. Your feedback and ideas are eagerly awaited, and we believe they will make a significant difference! :)

notes.title: Second Update - Balance and bug fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Update Highlights: [/h3]
[list]
[*] First levels are now easier.
[*] The actions have been accelerated, so as not to wait so long when there are many.
[*] The starting hand has at least three units. When a card is used, a random one from the deck is dealt.
[*] Introduced a "Sudden Death" rule! If after ten moves, each player has only one remaining unit on the board and no cards on deck, one energy point will be drained for every next move!
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when the bee killed a bomb dwarf.
[*] Minor bugs and text fixes.
[*] We added some testers to the credits who have made contributions to the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Slidemagi Launches in Early Access Today!
notes.content:
[h3]Join the Early Access Launch of Slidemagi![/h3]
Slidemagi is a turn-based strategy game in which units move by sliding the lines of the board. You are a Mage who, using your deck of cards, can summon spells or create units with unique abilities to fight under your control.
You choose how to have fun: Immerse yourself in adventure mode, earning new spells and units, or compete in tactical [b]online[/b] magical duels, where your strategic use of your Mage's deck determines your success against rivals.

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]
We chose the path of Early Access for Slidemagi with the conviction that active participation from our community is indispensable. This process allows us to adapt and evolve the game based on your experiences and feedback, ensuring that the final result is exceptional and rewarding for everyone.

[h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]
In the initial Early Access phase, Slidemagi delivers a full gaming experience with 3 areas and 15 levels for exploration. Players can dive into adventure mode, unlocking new units and spells, or engage in challenges against friends or the CPU. A tutorial section is also available to master strategy, units, and spells.

[h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3]
Absolutely, as we enrich Slidemagi with more content and gameplay features, we plan to raise the price accordingly.

[h3]Get involved in the development process![/h3]
We invite you to become an integral part of Slidemagi's development by joining our Discord community or leaving your comments in the discussions area. Your feedback and ideas are eagerly awaited, and we believe they will make a significant difference! :)
